text: Sensible. Leave me the console and we'll get along. I'm watching the numbers, not you.
style: An engineer in his late fifties who costed the deaths himself and signed the page. Consistent General American accent, Pacific Northwest, throughout -- do not shift to any other accent. Low-to-mid pitch; professorial and unhurried, a lecturer's cadence. Never defensive, because he does not think he is being accused of anything he has not already conceded.
